```plato
    // The affine part of a homogeneous matrix. Precondition: the matrix has no
    // projective component (its fourth column is 0, 0, 0, 1).
    AffineTransform3D(m: Matrix4x4): AffineTransform3D
        => AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3(
            Number3(m.Row1.X, m.Row1.Y, m.Row1.Z),
            Number3(m.Row2.X, m.Row2.Y, m.Row2.Z),
            Number3(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y, m.Row3.Z),
            Number3(m.Row4.X, m.Row4.Y, m.Row4.Z)));
```

## Line 445

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato, line 445](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato#L445).

```plato

    // The mirror as an affine map: translate the mirror's origin to the world
    // origin, reflect the basis, translate back.
    AffineTransform3D(r: Reflection3D): AffineTransform3D {
        var o = r.Origin.PositionVector;
        var n = r.Normal.Vector;
        var x = Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0).Reflect(n);
        var y = Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0).Reflect(n);
        var z = Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0).Reflect(n);
        var linear = AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3(
            Number3(x.X, x.Y, x.Z),
            Number3(y.X, y.Y, y.Z),
            Number3(z.X, z.Y, z.Z),
            Number3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)));
        return Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(-o).AffineTransform3D
            .Compose(linear)
            .Compose(Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(o).AffineTransform3D);
    }
```

```plato

    // The rotation about the centre as an affine map: translate the centre to
    // the world origin, rotate, translate back.
    AffineTransform3D(r: RotationAbout3D): AffineTransform3D {
        var c = r.Center.PositionVector;
        return Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(-c).AffineTransform3D
            .Compose(r.Rotation.AffineTransform3D)
            .Compose(Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(c).AffineTransform3D);
    }
```

```plato
    // The scaling about the centre as an affine map: translate the centre to the
    // world origin, scale, translate back.
    AffineTransform3D(s: ScalingAbout3D): AffineTransform3D {
        var c = s.Center.PositionVector;
        return Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(-c).AffineTransform3D
            .Compose(Matrix4x4.CreateScale(s.Amount).AffineTransform3D)
            .Compose(Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(c).AffineTransform3D);
    }
```

```plato
    // The linear map that sends the world axes to the basis vectors; the
    // translation row is zero, since a basis carries no origin.
    AffineTransform3D(b: Basis3D): AffineTransform3D
        => AffineTransform3D(Matrix4x3(
            Number3(b.X.X, b.X.Y, b.X.Z),
            Number3(b.Y.X, b.Y.Y, b.Y.Z),
            Number3(b.Z.X, b.Z.Y, b.Z.Z),
            Number3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)));
```
